instance.description: Which Knowledge Graph's glossary this is: its name, never a path.

prefLabel.description: The current label — what the term is shown as, and what a retired term keeps.

formerLabels.description: Labels this key carried before, oldest first — published as skos:hiddenLabel, so the old name still finds the term.

firstSeen.description: ISO date this key was first written.

retiredOn.description: ISO date it stopped being used, or null while it still is.

concepts.description: Keyed by the term IRI's local part, never the absolute IRI, so the file survives a change of address.

title: LedgerSchema
description: Generated from `LedgerSchema` in schemas/library/glossary-ledger.ts, which is authoritative. Published because it is an exported Zod `*Schema` (owner ruling 2026-10-05) — which says it is reachable, not that it is stable.
